selection_basis: Frozen structural rules and conventional local neighborhoods only; no full-sample performance result was used.

stability.neighborhood: Chebyshev distance <= 1 in grid-index space, including the focal combination
stability.plateau_node_rule: at least 4 valid neighbors, neighborhood median Sharpe > 0, stability score > 0, at least two thirds of neighbor Sharpes positive, and minimum neighbor trade count >= 30
stability.mechanism_plateau_rule: at least 2 adjacent combinations satisfying the plateau-node rule

atr_trend_flip.rationale: ATR memory and band distance are the two native SuperTrend structure controls.

channel_extreme_reversion.rationale: Channel memory jointly sets EMA and ATR periods; multiplier controls extremity.

compression_breakout.rationale: Compression rank horizon and breakout buffer define the setup and trigger.

gap_continuation.rationale: Gap size and confirmation volume are the two published continuation filters.

gap_fade.rationale: ATR memory and maximum fadeable gap size define eligible gaps.

ma_crossover_trend.rationale: The fast and slow EMA horizons define the crossover; ADX remains fixed.

momentum_confirmed_breakout.rationale: Breakout memory and trend-strength threshold define signal selectivity.

range_structure_reversion.rationale: Range memory and edge-zone depth define the reversion structure.

regression_equilibrium_reversion.rationale: Regression memory and residual deviation define equilibrium and entry extremity.

rolling_range_breakout.rationale: Donchian entry and exit horizons are the mechanism's native structural pair.

session_range_breakout.rationale: Opening-range duration and breakout buffer define the session structure and trigger.

short_horizon_pullback_reversion.rationale: RSI memory and symmetric entry extremity define the short-horizon pullback.

statistical_zscore_reversion.rationale: Estimation window and absolute z-entry threshold define the statistical signal.

trend_pullback_ma_structure.rationale: Separate proportional scaling of EMA 8/13/21 and EMA 34/55 tests local ribbon-horizon stability while retaining the five-EMA structure.

volatility_breakout.rationale: Daily ATR memory and opening-distance multiple define the volatility breakout.

vwap_equilibrium_reversion.rationale: VWAP deviation and minimum intraday formation time define entry selectivity.
